intro: Beat Bartleby is a straightforward test of martial mettle for aspiring Alliance warriors in Stormwind City. To fulfill an initiation task, the trainee must physically brawl with a stubborn town drunk who refuses to hand over his prized mug without a fight. Proving one's strength against him earns both his begrudging respect and the vessel required by the warrior trainers.
